diff:dojo-move.reason: new gate sub:<scenario> - sub/subn (the play-buffer subframe slot) were emitted by both traces and compared by NOTHING, so a port playing the wrong subframe could not fail. The two sides encode the slot differently: the JS counts 1..subn (its Te.Xh convention), the port 0..subn-1, so raw values differ on 197 of 568 dojo frames purely by convention (e.g. native 0 vs oracle 3 with subn=3). compare_pose now normalises the native 0 to subn and skips the oracle INT_MAX sentinel ('no active subframe'), and also compares subn. Measured after normalisation: 0/568 on dojo-move and 0/268 on kusarigama - the slot alignment is exact

disarm-ai.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): JS de.V1 L601-602 false-negative guard; metric 0 = no AI start of a move outside the fighter's own weapon-filtered list after a forced disarm (proven to fail at 1 with the filter disabled)

banner-round.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): JS Cr.init L84302-84321 geometry - the round digit must sit OUTSIDE the plate, 0.25a right of the art (round.x = b.N - 0.25a after both shift by -a/2). Proven to fail (502) with the old left-side formula

style-player-only.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): JS z3 L17296 / Fh.b6 - the style prize + achievement counter is the PLAYER's own level (proven: without the is_player guard the prize reads the enemy's level 2 instead of the player's 1)

enemy-kit.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): JS efa L7360 - a stage <Warrior><Groups> must resolve to a group member with its kit; proven to fail (items=0, weapon=Fists) with the group resolution disabled

cloth-hangs.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): the preview cloth must stay near its rest length. The JS mass-weighted relax moves the movable side by its own mass share only, so with the shipped masses (macro 0.00112 vs cloth 0.1) the cloth node free-fell from its macro; a pinned partner is treated as a hard constraint for PREVIEWS only. Proven: +289.6 without the branch (metric 1), +77.0 with it (0).

tutorial-chain-verify.reason: NEW gate (not a relaxation): the full fresh tutorial chain (no seed) - training fight -> knives Shop quest -> Map, driven with real injected clicks; it is the direct regression test for the reported 'the quests stop after the knives' (currently 3 pass / 0 fail)
